original: 現実の世界では、必ずしも善が悪に勝つとは限らないよ。

en.text: In the real world, good doesn't always triumph over evil.

original: ロシア人でもお酒好きだとは限りません。

en.text: Not all Russians are necessarily alcohol lovers, either.

original: 運命の人に会えたとしても，幸せになれるとは限らない。彼なんて結婚して子供は双子が生まれてバラ色の人生かと思った矢先に家族がみんな夜盗に殺された。

en.text: Even if you do meet the one for you, it's not a given that you'll be happy. Take him, for example. He got married and had twins for children, and just as he thought he'd have a rose-colored life, his whole family was killed by a robber at night.

original: 暑い時は、冷たいビールに限るね。

en.text: When it's hot, there's nothing like a cold beer.

original: 暑い時は、キーンと冷えたビールに限るね。

en.text: When it's hot, there's nothing like a ice cold beer.

original: 暑い時は、ビールに限るね。

en.text: Nothing beats a good beer when it's hot out.

original: ですが、いつもそうだとは限りません。

en.text: But this is not always the case.

original: シャワーをしている時に限って、なんでいつも電話がかかるんだ？

en.text: Why does the phone always ring when I'm in the shower?

original: 法律が必ずしも正しいとは限らない。

en.text: The law isn't always right.

original: 朝は、ブルーベリーマフィンに限る！

en.text: There's only blueberry muffins for breakfast!

original: 夏はスイカに限る！

en.text: In summer it's watermelon or nothing!
In summer limit yourself to watermelon!

original: 使い道が限られそうで買うのにためらう。

en.text: It seems like it's usage is limited so I hesitate to buy it.
